1 // Gandalf runtime host — the LIVE cross-family REFUTER orchestration (Wave W3).
2 //
3 // THE INTEGRATION POINT the deterministic gate never runs (seam/refute.mjs PRINCIPLE-D): the Tier-1
4 // host (runtime/seam-pass.applySeamPass) can only ever floor every elevation to SPECULATIVE because
5 // no INDEPENDENT named-defeater refuter actually ran — there was no live `agent()` seam and no minter.
6 // This module is that missing seam: for each high-value elevation that FIRES the refuter, it dispatches
7 // a REAL cross-family refuter (a Gemini `agy -p` sub-agent, drafter family = Claude) and, per genuine
8 // refutation, MINTS a claim-bound commission into the SAME per-run ledger applySeamPass resolves against.
9 // The result: a genuinely cross-family-refuted, surviving elevation reaches GROUNDED with cross_model:true
10 // — DERIVED from the unforgeable ledger, never self-asserted.
11 //
12 // THE FIVE LOAD-BEARING INVARIANTS (build task W3):
13 //   1. ONE SHARED PER-RUN LEDGER. The minter mints into `ledger.mintCommission` and applySeamPass
14 //      resolves via the SAME `ledger.resolveCommission`. A split ledger ⇒ every mint is a false
15 //      negative (the gate can never authenticate an id it did not see minted). The host constructs
16 //      ONE `createCommissionLedger()` and threads its resolver into applySeamPass.
17 //   2. MINT/GATE IDENTITY MATCH. The commission's result_digest is CLAIM-BOUND (seam/refute.mjs
18 //      elevationIdentity = id + reasoning + what_would_refute_it). We mint on the EXACT elevation
19 //      object we place into the returned draft — the SAME object applySeamPass hands to the gate
20 //      (isCrossFamilyRefutation) BEFORE ensureItemKeys runs — so the two identities are byte-identical.
21 //   3. ROUTING GUARD (never self-review). The refuter role MUST resolve to a NON-drafter family. If it
22 //      would resolve to the drafter family (claude) or to routes.default=claude, we HALT — a drafter
23 //      grading its own draft earns no independent origin and can never cross the single-family ceiling.
24 //   4. HONEST-HALT. If the refuter errors / returns empty / agy is down (the W0 seam throws HaltError on
25 //      a non-attested / substituted rec), the elevation gets NO provenance ⇒ it stays SPECULATIVE and
26 //      cross_model is NOT lifted. `survived` must be an EXPLICIT refuter boolean, never defaulted true.
27 //   5. BOUNDED BUDGET. More firing elevations than the pre-registered budget R ⇒ HALT (assertRefuterBudget;
28 //      no silent drop of the excess).
29 //
30 // Stdlib + the shipped gandalf seams only. The trio role-routed agent is a LAZY dynamic import (live
31 // path only), so importing THIS module never loads the trio and never spawns a subprocess — the
32 // deterministic test injects a stub agent + a fixture ledger and exercises the full mint→gate path with
33 // zero live calls.
34

92 /** Thrown by the routing guard when the refuter role would resolve to the DRAFTER family (self-review).
93  *  A distinct, NAMED class so the caller/test can assert the run HALTS rather than silently self-reviewing
94  *  on the drafter's own model (which earns no independent cross-family origin). */
95 export class SelfRefutationHalt extends Error {
96   constructor(refuterFamily, drafterFamily, driver) {
97     super(
98       `self-refutation HALT: the refuter role resolves to driver ${JSON.stringify(driver)} (family ` +
99       `${JSON.stringify(refuterFamily)}) which is the DRAFTER family ${JSON.stringify(drafterFamily)} — a ` +
100       `verification/refuter role MUST resolve to a NON-drafter family (never self-review). Route the ` +
101       `refuter role to a different model family (e.g. driver 'gemini-cli') or fix routes.default.`
102     );
103     this.name = 'SelfRefutationHalt';
104     this.refuter_family = refuterFamily;
105     this.drafter_family = drafterFamily;
106     this.driver = driver;
107   }
108 }
109 
110 /** Map a trio driver name to its model FAMILY (the leading token — STRICT prefix, never a substring, so
111  *  a label like 'claude-...-gemini-fallback' stamps claude, not gemini). Returns null for an
112  *  empty/unknown driver so the routing guard fails CLOSED (an unverifiable family is treated as unsafe). */
113 export function familyFromDriver(driver) {
114   const t = String(driver ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
115   if (!t) return null;
116   if (t.startsWith('gemini')) return 'gemini';
117   if (t.startsWith('claude')) return 'claude';
118   if (t.startsWith('openai') || t.startsWith('gpt')) return 'openai';
119   if (t.startsWith('grok')) return 'grok';
120   return t.split(/[\s\-_]/)[0] || null;
121 }
122 
123 /**
124  * ROUTING GUARD (invariant 3). Assert the refuter role resolves to a NON-drafter family. The refuter role
125  * resolves to `routes.refuter` (else `routes.default`); its driver's family MUST differ from
126  * `drafterFamily`. HALTs (SelfRefutationHalt) when it resolves to the drafter family OR to an
127  * unverifiable/empty driver (fail closed) — never self-review. Returns the resolved refuter family on pass.
128  * @param {{routes?:object, drafterFamily?:string}} [o]
129  * @returns {string} the resolved refuter family
130  */
131 export function assertCrossFamilyRouting({ routes = {}, drafterFamily = DRAFTER_FAMILY } = {}) {
132   const route = (routes && (routes.refuter || routes.default)) || {};
133   const driver = route.driver || null;
134   const refuterFamily = familyFromDriver(driver);
135   const drafter = String(drafterFamily ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
136   if (!refuterFamily || refuterFamily === drafter) {
137     throw new SelfRefutationHalt(refuterFamily, drafter, driver);
138   }
139   return refuterFamily;
140 }

142 /** The default refuter prompt: ask the independent (cross-family) refuter to ATTEMPT the elevation's
143  *  own named defeater and report, honestly, whether the claim SURVIVED it. Small by design (agy delivers
144  *  the prompt via ARGV; keep it well under the ~32KB limit and let the refuter read files itself). */
145 export function defaultRefutePrompt(elevation) {
146   const claim = String(elevation?.verdict ?? elevation?.reasoning ?? '').trim();
147   const namedDefeater = String(elevation?.what_would_refute_it ?? '').trim();
148   return (
149     `You are an INDEPENDENT cross-family refuter. A drafter (a different model family) elevated this ` +
150     `suggestion as high-value:\n\n  CLAIM: ${claim}\n  REASONING: ${String(elevation?.reasoning ?? '').trim()}\n\n` +
151     `The drafter named ONE concrete defeater that would falsify it:\n\n  NAMED DEFEATER: ${namedDefeater}\n\n` +
152     `Genuinely ATTEMPT that named defeater against the claim. Do NOT rubber-stamp it. Then answer, as a ` +
153     `single raw JSON object, with:\n` +
154     `  - "defeater": the concrete named defeater you actually attempted (a falsifying observation, NOT a ` +
155     `confidence word like "likely"/"unlikely"),\n` +
156     `  - "survived": a boolean — true iff the claim SURVIVED your attempted defeater; false iff the ` +
157     `defeater LANDED and breaks the claim,\n` +
158     `  - "verdict": one sentence explaining the outcome.\n` +
159     `Report survived HONESTLY — never default it to true.`
160   );
161 }
162 
163 /** Read the refuter's structured reply into `{ defeater, survived, verdict }`. Tolerant of the
164  *  gemini-cli ABSTAIN shape (`{answerable:'no',...}`) and of plain text — anything without an explicit
165  *  boolean `survived` + a named `defeater` is rejected downstream (⇒ no provenance ⇒ SPECULATIVE). */
166 export function extractRefuterVerdict(reply) {
167   if (!isPlainObject(reply)) return { defeater: undefined, survived: undefined, verdict: undefined };
168   return { defeater: reply.defeater, survived: reply.survived, verdict: reply.verdict };
169 }

171 /**
172  * runLiveRefutation — dispatch a live cross-family refuter for each FIRING elevation and MINT a
173  * claim-bound commission per genuine refutation into the SHARED per-run ledger.
174  *
175  * Returns a FRESH draft (the caller feeds it to applySeamPass with the SAME `ledger.resolveCommission`)
176  * plus a per-elevation dispatch log. PURE w.r.t. the input `rawDraft` (never mutates it — every touched
177  * elevation is a fresh copy). Each elevation the refuter genuinely runs on:
178  *   • survived:true  ⇒ mint a cross-family commission, attach the refutation_provenance carrying its id,
179  *     and REQUEST the GROUNDED tier (the gate still decides eligibility — labelTier only CAPS, so the
180  *     request is required to reach GROUNDED, and the derived ledger check governs whether it is granted);
181  *   • survived:false ⇒ the defeater LANDED ⇒ set rung REFUTED so the host drops it (only-REFUTED-drops);
182  *   • refuter error / empty / no explicit survived / non-named defeater ⇒ NO provenance ⇒ the host floors
183  *     it to SPECULATIVE (honest un-refuted floor). `survived` is NEVER defaulted true.
184  *
185  * @param {object} rawDraft                         the model's raw draft ({reasoning, verdict, ..., elevations[]})
186  * @param {object} o
187  * @param {Function} o.agent                        the role-routed `agent(prompt, {role,label,schema})`
188  * @param {object}   o.ledger                       the SHARED per-run commission ledger (createCommissionLedger())
189  * @param {?object}  [o.routes]                     the route table — when present the routing guard runs
190  * @param {string}   [o.drafterFamily='claude']
191  * @param {string}   [o.refuterFamily='gemini']
192  * @param {number}   [o.budget=REFUTER_BUDGET_R]    the bounded refuter budget R
193  * @param {Function} [o.refutePrompt]               (elevation)=>string prompt builder
194  * @param {string}   [o.role='refuter']
195  * @param {Function} [o.log]
196  * @returns {Promise<{draft:object, dispatch:object[]}>}
197  */
198 export async function runLiveRefutation(rawDraft, {
199   agent,
200   ledger,
201   routes = null,
202   drafterFamily = DRAFTER_FAMILY,
203   refuterFamily = REFUTER_FAMILY,
204   budget = REFUTER_BUDGET_R,
205   refutePrompt = defaultRefutePrompt,
206   role = 'refuter',
207   log = () => {},
208 } = {}) {
209   if (!isPlainObject(rawDraft)) {
210     throw new TypeError('runLiveRefutation: rawDraft must be a plain object');
211   }
212   if (!ledger || typeof ledger.mintCommission !== 'function' || typeof ledger.resolveCommission !== 'function') {
213     throw new TypeError('runLiveRefutation: a shared commission ledger { mintCommission, resolveCommission } is required (invariant 1)');
214   }
215   if (typeof agent !== 'function') {
216     throw new TypeError('runLiveRefutation: an injected role-routed agent(prompt, opts) is required');
217   }
218   // INVARIANT 3 — routing guard: a refuter role must resolve to a NON-drafter family (never self-review).
219   if (routes) assertCrossFamilyRouting({ routes, drafterFamily });
220 
221   const rawElevations = Array.isArray(rawDraft.elevations) ? rawDraft.elevations : [];
222 
223   // Which elevations FIRE the refuter (value-if-true ≥ HIGH OR severity ≥ major).
224   const firing = [];
225   rawElevations.forEach((e, i) => { if (isPlainObject(e) && firesRefuter(e)) firing.push(i); });
226   // INVARIANT 5, revised 2026-08-25 (John's ruling — elegance card + cost amendment; journals
227   // 0296/0298-0301: the frozen R=3 HALT fired on nearly every real read, was twice misread as
228   // "agy down", and shipped two avoidably-degraded deliverables). Cost is a PRE-FLIGHT
229   // conversation, never a mid-run wall: excess firing elevations no longer HALT the run — the
230   // top-R by value/severity get refuters; the excess ships UN-REFUTED and floors to SPECULATIVE
231   // by the existing honest-floor invariant, each named in the dispatch log. Nothing is silently
232   // dropped; paid-for output is never withheld (Gandalf's own locked law). The runaway ceiling
233   // (>4×R) also finishes-and-stamps — it only escalates the log line.
234   let toRefute = firing;
235   let floored = [];
236   if (firing.length > budget) {
237     const rank = (i) => {
238       const e = rawElevations[i];
239       const v = String(e?.value_if_true ?? '').toLowerCase() === 'high' ? 2 : 1;
240       // 2026-08-25 review fix: 'critical' outranks 'major' (it scored 0 — criticals
241       // were floored BEFORE majors under budget pressure, inverted priority).
242       const sev = String(e?.severity ?? '').toLowerCase();
243       const s = sev === 'critical' ? 2 : sev === 'major' ? 1 : 0;
244       return v * 10 + s;
245     };
246     const sorted = [...firing].sort((a, b) => rank(b) - rank(a) || a - b);
247     toRefute = sorted.slice(0, budget).sort((a, b) => a - b);
248     floored = sorted.slice(budget).sort((a, b) => a - b);
249     const nameOf = (i) => rawElevations[i]?.id ?? `e${i}`;
250     const ceiling = firing.length > Math.max(12, 4 * budget) ? ' RUNAWAY CEILING TRIPPED —' : '';
251     log(`refuter budget PRE-FLIGHT:${ceiling} ${firing.length} firing elevation(s) exceed budget ${budget} — FLOORING, not halting: refuting top ${budget} (${toRefute.map(nameOf).join(', ')}); ${floored.length} ship SPECULATIVE un-refuted (${floored.map(nameOf).join(', ')}). Re-run with --budget ${firing.length} to cover all.`);
252   }
253   const firingSet = new Set(toRefute);
254   const flooredSet = new Set(floored);
255 
256   // B3 (2026-07-11): firing elevations are INDEPENDENT — each gets its own refuter
257   // call, its own mint, its own provenance — so they dispatch CONCURRENTLY under a
258   // bounded cap instead of the old for-await serialization (which made the refuter
259   // leg the second-longest stage of every real run: N × tens of seconds, serial).
260   // Cap default 2 (agy OOMs above ~3 concurrent — the crucible/researchPrime caps
261   // encode the same host fact); GANDALF_REFUTER_CONCURRENCY overrides, ceiling 3.
262   // Determinism: results are placed by INDEX, dispatch is sorted by index, and the
263   // ledger mints in-process — output is order-independent of completion order.
264   const capEnv = Number(process.env.GANDALF_REFUTER_CONCURRENCY);
265   const cap = Math.min(3, Number.isFinite(capEnv) && capEnv > 0 ? capEnv : 2);
266 
267   const refuteOne = async (i) => {
268     const raw = rawElevations[i];
269     // INVARIANT 2 — the object the GATE will read. We mint on THIS exact object and place it in the
270     // returned draft, so elevationIdentity(bound) at mint === elevationIdentity(bound) at the gate.
271     const bound = { ...raw };
272     const label = `refuter:${raw.id ?? `e${i}`}`;
273     try {
274       const reply = await agent(refutePrompt(raw), { role, label, schema: REFUTER_REPLY_SCHEMA });
275       const { defeater, survived, verdict } = extractRefuterVerdict(reply);
276 
277       // INVARIANT 4 — survived must be an EXPLICIT boolean and defeater a NAMED concrete defeater;
278       // anything else ⇒ NO provenance ⇒ the host floors the elevation to SPECULATIVE (honest floor).
279       if (typeof survived !== 'boolean' || !isNamedDefeater(defeater)) {
280         return { index: i, bound, entry: { index: i, id: raw.id ?? null, minted: false, reason: 'refuter returned no explicit survived boolean and/or no named concrete defeater' } };
281       }
282 
283       const v = (verdict === undefined || verdict === null || verdict === '') ? null : String(verdict);
284       // The digest the commission is bound to — computed over THIS bound elevation's identity + the
285       // refuter content. composeRefutationProvenance recomputes the SAME digest from the SAME args
286       // (field parity: {defeater, survived, verdict} hashed == what the envelope stores), so the ledger
287       // tuple's result_digest === the provenance's result_digest === the gate's recomputed digest.
288       const result_digest = computeResultDigest({ elevation: bound, defeater, survived, verdict: v });
289       const commission_id = ledger.mintCommission({
290         drafter_family: drafterFamily,
291         refuter_family: refuterFamily,
292         result_digest,
293       });
294       const provenance = composeRefutationProvenance({
295         elevation: bound,
296         defeater,
297         survived,
298         verdict: v,
299         drafter_family: drafterFamily,
300         refuter_family: refuterFamily,
301         commission_id,
302       });
303       bound.refutation_provenance = provenance;
304 
305       if (survived === false) {
306         // The named defeater LANDED — the claim is refuted. Only-REFUTED-drops: the host will drop it.
307         bound.rung = 'REFUTED';
308       } else {
309         // A surviving, cross-family refutation REQUESTS the GROUNDED tier; the gate (derived cross_family
310         // eligibility from the shared ledger) is the sole authority that grants or caps it.
311         bound.tier = 'GROUNDED';
312       }
313       return { index: i, bound, entry: { index: i, id: raw.id ?? null, minted: true, survived, commission_id } };
314     } catch (err) {
315       // INVARIANT 4 (honest-HALT): the refuter errored / agy is down (W0 seam throws HaltError on a
316       // non-attested / substituted rec) / empty reply. The elevation gets NO provenance ⇒ SPECULATIVE ⇒
317       // cross_model NOT lifted. We NEVER fabricate a survived:true to manufacture a cross-family grant.
318       log(`!! ${label}: refuter failed (${err?.message ?? err}) — elevation stays SPECULATIVE (no provenance minted)`);
319       return { index: i, bound, entry: { index: i, id: raw.id ?? null, minted: false, reason: `refuter failed: ${err?.message ?? err}` } };
320     }
321   };
322 
323   // Bounded pool: `cap` workers drain the firing queue; per-elevation failures are
324   // handled INSIDE refuteOne (it never rejects), so one bad refuter cannot sink the batch.
325   const queue = [...toRefute];
326   const results = new Map(); // index -> { bound, entry }
327   await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(cap, queue.length) }, async () => {
328     while (queue.length) {
329       const i = queue.shift();
330       const r = await refuteOne(i);
331       results.set(r.index, r);
332     }
333   }));
334 
335   const outElevations = [];
336   const dispatch = [];
337   for (let i = 0; i < rawElevations.length; i++) {
338     const raw = rawElevations[i];
339     if (!isPlainObject(raw)) { outElevations.push(raw); continue; }
340     // Budget-floored elevations: fired but not refuted this run — recorded, never silent.
341     if (flooredSet.has(i)) {
342       outElevations.push({ ...raw });
343       dispatch.push({ index: i, id: raw.id ?? null, minted: false, reason: `budget floor (pre-flight): fired but not refuted this run — ships SPECULATIVE; re-run with --budget ${firing.length} to cover` });
344       continue;
345     }
346     // Below-threshold elevations earn no refuter — pass a fresh copy through (the host floors them).
347     if (!firingSet.has(i)) { outElevations.push({ ...raw }); continue; }
348     const r = results.get(i);
349     outElevations.push(r.bound);
350     dispatch.push(r.entry);
351   }
352 
353   return { draft: { ...rawDraft, elevations: outElevations }, dispatch };
354 }
355 
356 /**
357  * Build the LIVE role-routed agent from coding/review family prefs
358  * (refuter → REVIEW_FAMILY, drafter/default → CODING_FAMILY). Omit `routes` to honor prefs;
359  * pass an explicit table to pin. Runs the routing guard FIRST so a self-review route can never
360  * be built. ENV: forces CRUCIBLE_AGENT_LIVE=1. NOT called by the deterministic test.
361  * @param {{routes?:object, drafterFamily?:string, env?:object}} [o]
362  * @returns {Promise<Function>} the role-routed agent(prompt, opts)
363  */
364 /**
365  * The family that DRAFTED (2026-09-04, journal 0315): the session running this skill, not the
366  * dashboard's coding family — a Claude Code session drafts as claude even when coding_family is
367  * chatgpt. Explicit `drafterFamily` wins; then GANDALF_DRAFTER_FAMILY; then a Claude Code host
368  * (CLAUDECODE set) is claude; else the coding family.
369  */
370 export function resolveDrafterFamily({ drafterFamily, env = process.env, codingFamily } = {}) {
371   const pick = (v) => (typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() ? v.trim().toLowerCase() : null);
372   return pick(drafterFamily) || pick(env.GANDALF_DRAFTER_FAMILY) || (env.CLAUDECODE ? 'claude' : null) || pick(codingFamily) || DRAFTER_FAMILY;
373 }
374 
375 /**
376  * The refuter seat under the dashboard's rule (John, 2026-09-04): the configured family that is NOT
377  * the drafter's — review_family first (the check seat), then coding_family; null when every
378  * configured family is the drafter's (the caller HALTs honestly — never self-refutation, never a
379  * family nobody selected).
380  */
381 export function pickRefuterFamily({ families = {}, drafterFamily } = {}) {
382   const d = String(drafterFamily || '').toLowerCase();
383   for (const f of [families.review, families.coding]) {
384     const fam = String(f || '').toLowerCase();
385     if (fam && fam !== d) return fam;
386   }
387   return null;
388 }
389 
390 export async function buildLiveRefuterAgent({ routes, drafterFamily, env = process.env } = {}) {
391   const { makeRoleRoutedAgent, buildRoutesFromFamilies, familyToDriverName } = await import('file:///C:/dev/trio/drivers/index.mjs');
392   const built = buildRoutesFromFamilies({
393     env,
394     codingRoles: [],
395     reviewRoles: ['refuter'],
396   });
397   const resolvedDrafter = resolveDrafterFamily({ drafterFamily, env, codingFamily: built.families?.coding });
398   let resolvedRoutes = routes;
399   if (!resolvedRoutes) {
400     // (2026-09-04) refuter = the configured non-drafter family; review_family first.
401     const fam = pickRefuterFamily({ families: built.families || {}, drafterFamily: resolvedDrafter });
402     const drv = fam ? familyToDriverName(fam) : null;
403     resolvedRoutes = drv ? { ...built.routes, refuter: { driver: drv } } : built.routes;
404   }
405   // Fail-closed: a refuter that resolves to the drafter's family is a self-refutation HALT.
406   assertCrossFamilyRouting({ routes: resolvedRoutes, drafterFamily: resolvedDrafter });
407   return makeRoleRoutedAgent({ routes: resolvedRoutes, env: { ...env, CRUCIBLE_AGENT_LIVE: '1' } });
408 }
